offering_description.value: LSB makes nitrogen fertilizers for agricultural distributors and nitrogen chemicals for industrial manufacturers and mining explosives suppliers. It uses natural gas to make ammonia and converts much of that ammonia into other nitrogen products at its U.S. plants. It also operates a nitric acid plant under contract for a chemical manufacturer.

primary_products.value: ammonia; urea ammonium nitrate solution; ammonium nitrate; nitric acid; sulfuric acid

primary_services.value: contract operation of a nitric acid plant

customer_segment.value: B2B: fertilizer distributors and dealers, industrial chemical manufacturers, mining explosives suppliers

end_markets.value: crop agriculture; industrial chemical manufacturing; mining and quarrying

revenue_model.value: product sales: bulk fertilizers and industrial and mining chemicals; project or contract: long-term operation of a nitric acid plant for a chemical manufacturer

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts natural gas into ammonia and derivative chemicals for fertilizer dealers, chemical manufacturers and explosives suppliers; asset operator: owns and runs chemical plants supplying agricultural and industrial customers; service provider: operates a nitric acid plant for a chemical manufacturer
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: US national: U.S. customers served from operations in Arkansas, Oklahoma, Alabama and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: nitrogen fertilizers, industrial acids and ammonia, and ammonium nitrate for mining explosives

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bulk supply agreements with agricultural, industrial and mining customers; distributors / dealers: fertilizer distributors and agricultural dealers serving growers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA environmental permitting, OSHA chemical process safety requirements and DOT hazardous materials transport rules

notes: The current extent of sales outside the United States is uncertain.
